640-1339-1832-2034.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
640-1339-1832-2034.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

225-2493-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
225-2493-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Archaeomancer and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Archaeomancer and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
Repeat from step 1.
225-2493-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Archaeomancer and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

132-1379-4687-4851.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-1379-4687-4851.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.

2724-3217-3582-3899.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

222-527-7175-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-7175-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3899-5571-7666--6.description:
Use Bilbo, Luckwearer // Burglar's Plot to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Land that adds at least two mana

1682-4019-4221--85--172.description:
Play the land that taps for multiple mana.
That land enters as a creature due to Living Plane, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least two mana.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
1682-4019-4221--85--172.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

If the land adds at least {2}{U}, the additional mana source is not necessary.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2719-7193.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2719-7193.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Omni-Changeling and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Omni-Changeling trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2719-7193.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

3443-4091-7791.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
3443-4091-7791.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Deathbloom Ritualist.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Deathbloom Ritualist.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5147-5542-6145.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6145.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Passageway Seer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Passageway Seer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Passageway Seer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Passageway Seer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Passageway Seer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5147-5542-6145.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-6797-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it.
978-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1453-2438--5.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Arwen
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat

1172-1624-1860.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Emergence Zone by paying {1}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, allowing you to cast spells as though they had flash this turn.
Cast Channel by paying {G}{G}.
Activate Channel by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

2921-6255-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2921-6255-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Zahur and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

338-4050-5086-5183-6753.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-4050-5086-5183-6753.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color
Repeat from step 1.

1651-3340-4365-6871.description:
Activate Bootleggers' Stash by tapping it, as it's a land due to Toph, creating two Treasure tokens due to Mondrak.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Bootleggers' Stash.
Repeat.

444-2894-4389-7123.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
444-2894-4389-7123.description:
Attempt to draw a card. 
The draw will be replaced by Chains of Mephistopheles, instead causing you to discard Grave-Shell Scarab. Then, the draw will be replaced by Grave-Shell Scarab's dredge ability, causing you to mill cards and return Grave-Shell Scarab from your graveyard to your hand.
Dredger's Insight's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Drogskol Reaver triggers, attempting to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

1558-6741-7012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five multicolored permanents.
1558-6741-7012.description:
Cast Infinite Guideline Station either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Infinite Guideline Station's station ability by tapping any number of creatures with total power 12 or greater, putting at least twelve charge counters on Infinite Guideline Station, causing it to become a creature.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Robots, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Infinite Guideline Station.
When Infinite Guideline Station enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Repeat from step 3 each turn.

2146-3532-5078-6608.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

63-1368-3698-4231-6293.easyPrerequisites: For each listed card above that is in your graveyard, you must have three additional cards in your graveyard.
63-1368-3698-4231-6293.description:
Cast Wernog either from your hand, graveyard or from the command zone by paying {W}{B} plus commander tax or exiling three cards from your graveyard, if necessary.
When Wernog enters, it triggers, causing you to create at least one Food, one Clue and one Treasure.
When the artifact tokens enter, Grinding Station trigger that many times.
Resolve a Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Grinding Station by sacrificing a Clue or Food, causing you to mill three cards.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time. Then, resolve any remaining Grinding Station triggers, untapping it.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Cast Metamorphosis either from your hand or from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {G} and exiling three cards from your graveyard, if necessary, and sacrificing Wernog.
When Wernog dies, it triggers, causing you to create at least one Food, one Clue and one Treasure.
Repeat steps 3 through 6 once.
Resolve Metamorphosis, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W/B}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-1270-4365-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1270-4365-6441.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

104-1274-2645-4929.description:
Activate Staff of Domination's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Cleric Class and Heliod trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
104-1274-2645-4929.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

1940-4050-5544-6822.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lyla trigger.
Repeat.

204-1858-2056-2633-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-1858-2056-2633-6791.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Urabrask and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

864-974-1235.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating a token copy of the Smaug token and Eternal Witness with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Smaug token that died and the Eternal Witness token trigger.
Resolve the Smaug trigger, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

1497-4893-4949-5217.description:
Activate Order of Whiteclay by tapping it, adding {W} that can only be spent to activate an ability of a creature.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {W}{W} and untapping it, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

372-1974-4681.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Quicksilver Gargantuan.
372-1974-4681.description:
Cast Quicksilver Gargantuan by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Quicksilver Gargantuan's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Quicksilver Gargantuan leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Quicksilver Gargantuan into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Quicksilver Gargantuan from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

5195-6259-6313.description:
Cast Shattering Pulse with buyback by paying {R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Shattering Pulse, destroying an artifact and returning Shattering Pulse to your hand.
When there is another artifact you wish to destroy, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}, and then repeat from step 1.
5195-6259-6313.notes: If you or an opponent control an artifact with indestructible, you may do this loop infinitely targeting that artifact for infinite storm count and magecraft triggers. You may also repeat this loop whenever an artifact enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

333-2511-5617.notablePrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2511-5617.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

751-2653-3147-3314.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

198-4331-4404.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least three charge counters on it.
198-4331-4404.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {U} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {1}{U}.
When Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

880-2374-2653.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Nissa and Maja trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

386-3946-5064.notablePrerequisites:
Glistening Oil attached to Skirk Fire Marshal.
You control at least five untapped Goblins.
386-3946-5064.description:
Activate Skirk Fire Marshal by tapping five untapped Goblins, giving each creature ten -1/-1 counters and giving each opponent ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten poison counters.

914-1235-3368-4863.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1235-3368-4863.description:
Cast Twinflame with Strive by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting Revolutionist and Dockside Extortionist.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate by paying {1}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Twinflame.
Resolve the Twinflame copy, creating a token copy of Revolutionist and Dockside Extortionist.
Revolutionist and Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield triggers.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Reiterate from your graveyard to hand.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

803-1869-3089-3821.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
"Wizard" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1869-3089-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying {4}{U}.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it and Inalla trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Barrin by paying {2} and sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, returning the nontoken Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

981-1517-1532-4377.notablePrerequisites: The Mirari Conjecture has two lore counters on it.
981-1517-1532-4377.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on itself, sacrificing itself and copying all instant and sorcery spells you cast this turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, creating a copy of Walk the Aeons.
Resolve both Walk the Aeonss, getting two extra turns after this one.
Cast Faith's Reward by paying {3}{W}.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, copying Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Cursecatcher by sacrificing it, countering the original Faith's Reward.
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning The Mirari Conjecture and Cursecatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on itself and returning Faith's Reward from your graveyard to your hand.
Proceed to your next turn.
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Mirari Conjecture triggers, putting a lore counter on itself and returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Proceed to your next turn.
Repeat.
